title: Steered (skidded) turns
subtitle: Seen from the front, and what your boots will show
steps: Pivot both skis across the fall line and let the tails slide.
Control your speed by how far you turn across the hill.

callouts.text: Low, rounded humps: little edge tilt, and the skis point across the line you travel.
A gentler crossing: the skis pivot more than they roll.
Compare with carving: carved humps are taller and the crossing is sharper.

footnote: Illustration of a typical shape, not a target. Tilt is relative, not degrees.
